name: rpcedge-toolkit
description: rpc edge developer toolkit: TypeScript SDK, CLI, and MCP server for Solana trading infra.
author: 0xNyk <0xnykcd@googlemail.com>

scripts.build: pnpm --filter rpcedge-core run build && pnpm --filter rpcedge-sdk run build && pnpm --filter rpcedge run build && pnpm --filter rpcedge-mcp run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --filter './packages/*' run --if-present test
